partido: Mbappé youngest to 100 Champions League games
text:
Kylian Mbappé reached 100 Champions League games at 27 years 298 days — 5 months younger than Lionel Messi (28y 84d). He scored in Roma 3-4 Real Madrid. Mbappé or Messi in Europe? 👇
#Mbappe #Messi #RealMadrid #ChampionsLeague #Football
titulo: Mbappé breaks Messi's Champions League record
